title: PowerPoint on the web: Copilot agent notifies you when work is complete or needs attention
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts and existing licence controls are supported, and searches confirm the narrowly stated documentation gaps. One descriptive sentence goes beyond the evidence by saying notifications reach users outside the PowerPoint tab; Microsoft has not documented their delivery surface.

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 admin center > Users > Active users > user > Licenses and Apps > Licenses reaches the user licence control.
claims.quote: go to the **Users** > [Active users] ... Select the row of the user ... select **Licenses and Apps**. ... Expand the **Licenses** section, select the boxes for the licenses that you want to assign

claims.claim: The printed Set-MgUserLicense command assigns the selected SKU to the identified user using Microsoft Graph PowerShell.
claims.quote:
To assign a license to a user, use the following command in PowerShell.
Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @()

claims.claim: Assigning licences requires at least a License Administrator or User Administrator.
claims.quote: You must be at least a License or User Administrator to assign licenses.

claims.claim: The licence row controls user licence assignment rather than documenting a notification on/off switch.
claims.quote: When you use the **Active users** page to assign or unassign licenses, you assign or unassign users licenses to products.

claims.claim: Copilot > Settings is the documented place to browse Copilot settings in the Microsoft 365 admin center.
claims.quote: In the left navigation, expand **Copilot**, and then select **Settings**.

claims.claim: The cited settings page lists User access, Data access, Copilot actions and Other settings without a notification setting.
claims.quote: Browse **User access**, **Data access**, **Copilot actions**, and **Other settings**. Select **View all** or **All settings** when a setting isn't shown in a category.

claims.claim: These notifications can reach users outside the PowerPoint tab.
claims.quote: Searched: 'PowerPoint Copilot agent notifications content delivery complete requires attention waiting user away'; 'PowerPoint notifications completion Copilot'. Read roadmap, release notes and agent documentation; leaving PowerPoint is planned, but no delivery surface is specified.
